notes.title: Update Patch Notes - May 28, 2019
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35021308/da7d95dfe53b0cfe89d6190caa2ab05d40d8132e.png
The following updates have been implemented:

Added: Crash-Kill bonus
(+ bonus score for killing people with crashed ufo)

Added: Selectable Cities
(New York, Moscow, Tokyo)

Added: New Achievements
Cliffhanger - (Throw down 100 Climbers)
Bomberman - (Blow up 100 Bombermans)

Enjoy the game! :)
